_README: Template for real executor/reviewer runs. Copy it, fill it in OUTSIDE the repository,
and never commit the copy. Nothing here contains or should contain a secret.
ENTRY POINT: tick.py. It supports mode 'replay' and mode 'live'; controller.py's own
CLI is a replay-only convenience and is not the activation path. Enabling live
dispatch is a CONFIG change (the two enabled flags below), not a code change.
Live dispatch stays OFF until every one of these is true:
1. runners[*].enabled = true, deliberately, in a copy outside the repository
2. the credentials below exist in the environment of whatever runs tick.py
3. the stop file path is writable by whoever must be able to stop this
4. a persistent caller invokes tick.py (see ACTIVATION.md and CAPABILITIES.md)
run_budget is a count of RUNS. It is not a spending authorisation and proves
nothing about billing; see the authentication row in CAPABILITIES.md.

command: You are the EXECUTOR. Read {prompt_file}. Work at {head}. Emit JSON: {"new_head": "<40-hex sha>"}.

You are the INDEPENDENT REVIEWER. You did not write this. Review {head} from a fresh clone. Emit JSON: {"review": {"head": "...", "reviewer": "...", "decision": "APPROVED|APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS|BLOCKED|NEEDS_INFORMATION", "evidence": ["..."]}}.

_time_limits_note: timeout_seconds at the top level bounds one review ROUND (45 min).
Each runner's own timeout_seconds bounds one model call (20 min).
A runner that overruns is killed together with every process it started;
terminate_grace_seconds is how long SIGTERM is given before SIGKILL.
Repository test suites, when run, belong under the pr_tests role, which
receives no credential at all; budget them at 10 minutes.

executor: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN - the model call
GITHUB_TOKEN - push to the work branch only
reviewer: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN - the model call
NO write token: the reviewer produces evidence, and evidence does not need push rights
pr_tests: nothing. Untrusted repository code runs with no credential of any kind.
_note: This is the ALLOWLIST, enforced in runners.build_env. Every other variable in
the parent environment is dropped, including ones added later. It is not
configurable from this file on purpose: a config a pull request could edit

run_budget_note: Unit is RUNS, not currency. One runner invocation costs 1. A run cap bounds how many times a model is called; it says nothing about which authentication path is used or whether that path bills. Those are separate and are recorded in CAPABILITIES.md.
